info.name: Smart Report Engine — Railway (Production)
info.description:
Complete API collection for Smart Report Engine deployed on Railway.

Base URL: https://smart-report-engine-production.up.railway.app

Folders:
1. 🏥 Health & System — Server status and metrics
2. 🏢 Tenants — Tenant lookup
3. 📄 Reports (JSON) — Generate HTML and PDF reports from raw JSON
4. 🔬 FHIR Ingestion — Generate reports from FHIR R4 Bundles
5. 📡 HL7 Ingestion — Generate reports from HL7 v2.5 messages
6. ❌ Error Cases — Validation and 404 error scenarios

variable.description: Railway production base URL. Change to http://localhost:3000 for local testing.

request.description:
Returns server status, environment, uptime, and all registered page types.

Expected response:
- status: "ok"
- environment: "production"
- uptime: seconds since start
- registeredPages: array of all page module names

Returns all collected metrics in Prometheus text format.

Includes:
- sre_ingestion_total — total report generation requests
- sre_cache_hit_total / sre_cache_miss_total — cache performance
- sre_pdf_generation_total — PDF jobs completed
- sre_pdf_duration_ms — PDF generation latency
- sre_report_duration_ms — total request latency
- sre_severity_total — report severity distribution
- sre_error_total — error counts by type
- sre_audit_total — audit records saved

Fetch config for the 'demo' tenant (Sai Health Labs).
reportType: inDepth | webViewer: true

Fetch config for 'tenant-alpha' (Alpha Diagnostics).
reportType: essential | webViewer: false

Fetch config for 'tenant-beta' (NexaHealth Analytics).
reportType: inDepth | webViewer: true

Generate a full InDepth HTML report for tenant-beta.

Response fields:
- html: complete HTML string of the report
- overallScore: 0-100 health score
- overallSeverity: 'normal' | 'monitor' | 'critical'
- renderedPages: list of pages rendered
- skippedPages: list of pages skipped (empty data)

⚠️ PDF generation takes 15-40 seconds — increase Postman timeout accordingly.
Settings → General → Request timeout → set to 60000ms

Response fields:
- pdfBase64: base64-encoded PDF (decode and save as .pdf to view)
- overallScore: 0-100
- overallSeverity: normal | monitor | critical
- renderedPages: pages included in PDF
- skippedPages: pages with no data
Essential tier report for tenant-alpha. Generates a shorter report with Cover, Summary, Blood Panel, Recommendations pages only.

Uses 'demo' tenant which has webViewer:true — this generates a real QR code embedded in the report that links to the patient mobile viewer (/view/:token).

Check the response HTML for a scannable QR code!

Ingest a FHIR R4 Bundle and generate an HTML report.

The bundle contains:
- Patient resource (demographics)
- Observation resources (lab results with LOINC codes)
- DiagnosticReport resource (groups observations into profiles)

⚠️ PDF generation takes 15-40 seconds. Set Postman timeout to 60000ms.

Returns pdfBase64 — copy it and decode to save as a .pdf file.
Expected: 400 error — empty entry array fails the Zod schema validation (min 1 entry required).

Ingest an HL7 v2.5 ORU^R01 message.

Message structure:
- MSH: Message header
- PID: Patient identification
- OBR: Test order (one per profile)
- OBX: Observation result (one per parameter)

Reference ranges are parsed from the OBX segment (field 7).

⚠️ PDF generation takes 15-40 seconds. Set Postman timeout to 60000ms.

Returns pdfBase64 — decode it to save as a .pdf file.
Expected: 422 HL7_PARSE_FAILED — invalid HL7 message format.
Expected: 400 INVALID_BODY — tenantId and reportData are required.
Expected: 404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND — the tenantId 'unknown-tenant' does not exist.
